canonical_statement: Every subgroup of every free group is free.

canonical_formal_target.serialization: Statement.lean emits the target with pp.universes=true and pp.explicit=true; check_statement.py hashes the extracted expression bytes and complete Lean output.
canonical_formal_target.fully_explicit_expression:
∀ (G : Type u) [inst : Group.{u} G] [@IsFreeGroup.{u} G inst] (H : @Subgroup.{u} G inst),
  @IsFreeGroup.{u} (↥H) (@Subgroup.toGroup.{u} G inst H)

domain_and_universes: universe u; G : Type u; [Group G]; [IsFreeGroup G]; H : Subgroup G; conclusion IsFreeGroup H in Prop; the inherited subgroup group structure and free bases use the same universe u.
hypotheses: G admits a free-group basis in universe u
H is an arbitrary subgroup of G
conclusion: IsFreeGroup H using H's inherited group structure; equivalently, H has a FreeGroupBasis indexed by some Type u.
minimal_import_basis: The sole module supplies Group, Subgroup, FreeGroup, FreeGroupBasis, IsFreeGroup, and the literal FreeGroup freeness instance. Deleting it makes the module fail. The proof-bearing Mathlib.GroupTheory.FreeGroup.NielsenSchreier module is absent and subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree is checked unavailable.

checked_alternate_encodings.boundary: The literal FreeGroup carrier is equivalent to the generic basis-based carrier; the reverse direction transports an arbitrary subgroup along IsFreeGroup.mulEquiv.
This expands IsFreeGroup H to existence of an index type in universe u and a FreeGroupBasis for H.

included: the trivial free group and its bottom subgroup
the top subgroup of every generic free group
subgroups of infinitely generated free groups
finite and infinite rank, index, and carrier cardinality
excluded_assumptions: Finite G, Finite H, Fintype G, or Fintype H
H is normal, cyclic, or non-bottom
